start.notes: Started inline from SAIL by NSSOL_GRID_Projects via a!startProcess3 (D03 ¶193–203), not by a record action.

updateConstant.notes: TL-1: the diagram declares 'Script Task / Service Task'; modelled as a service task. LanguageToggleStore is a proposed test double standing in for the NSSOL_BOOL_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE constant (TL-2).

assumptions.text: The flow node is declared 'Script Task / Service Task' (D03 ¶184), so its type is undecided in the source. Modelled as a service task bound to a CDI bean.

BAMOE has no Appian constants. LanguageToggleStore (proposed test double) records the value written to NSSOL_BOOL_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE; where the global value is persisted and how the interfaces read it back is unspecified (D03 ¶185–186, D06 ¶101). The task returns toggleValue unchanged.

support.quote: all interfaces read from this same constant at render time

assumptions.text: toggleValue is documented as not required and without a default (D03 ¶175); behaviour when it is null is undocumented, so it is passed to the write unchanged and no scenario covers it.

support.quote: | `toggleValue` | Boolean | Yes | No | The new value to write to the language constant |

assumptions.text: The flip happens in the caller, before the process starts: SAIL flips local!isToggleOn and passes the new value (D03 ¶196–203, D04 ¶128–130). The process flips nothing and the SAIL trigger is not modelled.

support.quote: if(local!isToggleOn, false(), true())  // flip the toggle

assumptions.text: No start restriction is coded: the role map has no INITIATOR group (D03 ¶242), and D07 accepts this as a POC risk while suggesting a restriction to NP Administrators for production (D07 ¶134, ¶216). The dev profile has auth disabled (same gap as C3 for Register Project).

support.quote: No explicit INITIATOR or MANAGER group assignments (open to all authenticated users)
in production, this toggle button may need to be restricted to NP Administrators only
Restrict to NP Administrators if needed

assumptions.text: Appian lifecycle attributes (timezone GMT+12, auto-archive 7 days, auto-delete 0 days, notifications) are not carried into the BPMN; the BAMOE skeleton has no equivalent.

Target-design proposals pending approval: service class nssol.service.LanguageToggleStore with operation update, taking and returning the Boolean toggleValue; scenarios are generated as start-only (the process has no user task).

CONFLICT: D03 ¶211 calls NSSOL_PM_UPDATE_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE a constant holding the process model reference; D04 ¶364 documents the same UUID suffix _2006990 as a 'Utility Interface'. Neither object is modelled (the process is started directly), so the flow is unaffected; what kind of object it is stays open.

support.quote: The constant `NSSOL_PM_UPDATE_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE` (`_a-..._2006990`) holds the reference to this process model

assumptions.text: CONFLICT: D03 ¶165–166 and D07 ¶189 give auto-archive after 7 days and then immediate (0 days) deletion, while D03 ¶206 says the process 'self-deletes' right after running. Whether the instance disappears at once or on day 7 is not stated consistently. Not modelled (see TL-6).

support.quote: it runs immediately, updates the constant, and self-deletes (auto-delete = 0 days)
| NSSOL Update Language Toggle | 7 days | **0 days** (immediate) | Utility — deleted instantly |

assumptions.text: CONFLICT: D01 ¶120 says the process persists 'the preference' (reads as per user); D07 ¶134 says it changes the language for every user. Model follows the flow: one global write, no user key.

assumptions.text: CONFLICT: the SAIL control that starts the process is a globe icon link in D01 ¶120 and a labelled toolbar button ('Switch Language' / '言語切替') in D04 ¶125–126. UI only; the process is unaffected.
